summary: Review of 5 agents/ files reveals a mix of quality levels. DSL-PATTERNS.md documentation is excellent (9/10). The Scheme DSL files (persona-prompt-gen.ss at 7/10, catalyst-dsl.ss at 8/10) are well-designed but have portability and fragile indexing concerns. invoke-haiku.js (5/10) needs better error handling and resource cleanup. feature-dev.ss (6/10) has stale references and redundant code that should use existing utilities.
